$comment: Cross-layer delta L0206-D002 (AI-003 raw ToolCall.arguments JavaScript value domain). Scenarios live in conformance/agent/raw-arguments/*.json, discriminated by a top-level `raw_arguments` key. For each case a runner builds ONE ToolCall whose arguments are the case's value (fixture input, decoded from the value grammar), then observes that value -- by value, never by identity -- at every certified boundary: the constructed ToolCall.arguments; an AssistantMessage holding the call appended to a fresh session log and replayed from it (decode of the logged event); the tools/execution-start payload; the tools/pre-execute listener; and execute, for a tool WITHOUT prepare_arguments whose schema is {type: object, properties: {}}. Every boundary must observe exactly `arguments`. The runner performs no decoding, normalization or conversion on the pipeline's behalf. VALUE GRAMMAR: {"utf16": units} is a string (units = UTF-16 code units 0..65535, so unpaired surrogates survive the file); {"number": token} is a number (token as prepared-runtime-scenario.schema.json: "+Infinity", "-Infinity", "NaN", "-0", or a finite JSON number literal denoting a finite binary64 value; an integral literal within the binding's integer representation is an integer); {"$keys": [[units, value], ...]} is an object whose keys need code units; any other object is an object with those (ASCII) keys; an array is an array; true/false/null are themselves. OBJECTS COMPARE AS KEY SETS: enumeration order is L0206-D001's (K1), not this shape's. `provider_text` is the provider's argument text pinned Pi decoded (evidence only: Minion has no certified raw decoder; a future decoder must produce `arguments` from it).
